name: jpmmatias
description: Learncraft: turn your AI coding agent into a personal learning environment. Skills by João Pedro Matias.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Learncraft: turn your AI coding agent into a personal learning environment. Quick explanations, one-sitting lessons and multi-session courses with practice, spaced review and evidence-gated milestones, as local files.

plugins.name: lesson-panel
plugins.description: Learncraft lesson panel: the next lesson is written, then reviewed by independent expert, novice and course-flow subagents in capped rounds. Needs the learn plugin.

plugins.name: curriculum-planner
plugins.description: Learncraft curriculum planner: turns a course mission and diagnostic into milestones, lessons and objectives in assets/course.js, with motion, lab and prerequisite decisions. Needs the learn plugin.

plugins.name: source-researcher
plugins.description: Learncraft source researcher: fills RESOURCES.md for a lesson with fetched, tiered and dated sources and a claims ledger, so lessons never cite an invented link. Needs the learn plugin.

plugins.name: challenge-reviewer
plugins.description: Learncraft challenge reviewer: grades a learner's challenge against its stated criteria, writes the learning record, and masters a milestone only when every criterion is met. Needs the learn plugin.
